units.leftText: How the city sits solitary, She weeps bitterly in the night.
units.rightText: How lonely lies the city, She weeps aloud in the night,

units.leftText: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction The roads to Zion mourn,
units.rightText: Judah has gone into exile The roads to Zion mourn,

units.leftText: Her adversaries have become the head. All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: Her foes have become her masters; All the splendor has departed

units.leftText: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries Jerusalem has grievously sinned.
units.rightText: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem has sinned greatly;

units.leftText: Her filthiness was in her skirts. The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things;
units.rightText: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; The adversary has seized

units.leftText: All her people sigh. “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?
units.rightText: All her people groan Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by?

units.leftText: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand.
units.rightText: He sent fire from on high, My transgressions are bound into a yoke,

units.leftText: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. “For these things I weep.
units.rightText: The Lord has rejected For these things I weep;

units.leftText: Zion spreads out her hands. “The LORD is righteous,
units.rightText: Zion stretches out her hands, The LORD is righteous,

units.leftText: “I called for my lovers, “Look, LORD; for I am in distress.
units.rightText: I called out to my lovers, See, O LORD, how distressed I am!

units.leftText: “They have heard that I sigh. “Let all their wickedness come before you.
units.rightText: People have heard my groaning, Let all their wickedness come before You,

units.leftText: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob
units.rightText: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion Without pity the Lord has swallowed up

units.leftText: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has bent his bow like an enemy.
units.rightText: In fierce anger He has cut off He has bent His bow like an enemy;

units.leftText: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has violently taken away his tabernacle,
units.rightText: The Lord is like an enemy; He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth;

units.leftText: The Lord has cast off his altar. The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: The Lord has rejected His altar; The LORD determined to destroy

units.leftText: Her gates have sunk into the ground. The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground.
units.rightText: Her gates have sunk into the ground; The elders of the Daughter of Zion

units.leftText: My eyes fail with tears. They ask their mothers,
units.rightText: My eyes fail from weeping; They cry out to their mothers:

units.leftText: What shall I testify to you? Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you.
units.rightText: What can I say for you? The visions of your prophets

units.leftText: All that pass by clap their hands at you. All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you.
units.rightText: All who pass by All your enemies

units.leftText: The LORD has done that which he planned. Their heart cried to the Lord.
units.rightText: The LORD has done what He planned; The hearts of the people

units.leftText: Arise, cry out in the night, “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus!
units.rightText: Arise, cry out in the night Look, O LORD, and consider:

units.leftText: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side.
units.rightText: Both young and old lie together You summoned my terrors on every side,

units.leftText: I am the man who has seen affliction He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness,
units.rightText: I am the man who has seen affliction He has driven me away and made me walk

units.leftText: Surely he turns his hand against me He has made my flesh and my skin old.
units.rightText: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand He has worn away my flesh and skin;

units.leftText: He has built against me, He has made me dwell in dark places,
units.rightText: He has besieged me and surrounded me He has made me dwell in darkness

units.leftText: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. Yes, when I cry, and call for help,
units.rightText: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; Even when I cry out and plead for help,

units.leftText: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He is to me as a bear lying in wait,
units.rightText: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He is a bear lying in wait,

units.leftText: He has turned away my path, He has bent his bow,
units.rightText: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He bent His bow

units.leftText: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys. I have become a derision to all my people,
units.rightText: He pierced my kidneys I am a laughingstock to all my people;

units.leftText: He has filled me with bitterness. He has also broken my teeth with gravel.
units.rightText: He has filled me with bitterness; He has ground my teeth with gravel

units.leftText: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I said, “My strength has perished,
units.rightText: My soul has been deprived of peace; So I say, “My strength has perished,

units.leftText: Remember my affliction and my misery, My soul still remembers them,
units.rightText: Remember my affliction and wandering, Surely my soul remembers

units.leftText: This I recall to my mind; It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed,
units.rightText: Yet I call this to mind, Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed,

units.leftText: They are new every morning. “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul.
units.rightText: They are new every morning; “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul,

units.leftText: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, It is good that a man should hope
units.rightText: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, It is good to wait quietly

units.leftText: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth. Let him sit alone and keep silence,
units.rightText: It is good for a man to bear the yoke Let him sit alone in silence,

units.leftText: Let him put his mouth in the dust, Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him.
units.rightText: Let him bury his face in the dust— Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him;

units.leftText: For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he causes grief,
units.rightText: For the Lord will not Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion

units.leftText: For he does not afflict willingly, To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
units.rightText: For He does not willingly afflict To crush underfoot

units.leftText: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High, to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
units.rightText: to deny a man justice to subvert a man in his lawsuit—

units.leftText: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
units.rightText: Who has spoken and it came to pass, Do not both adversity and good

units.leftText: Why should a living man complain, Let us search and try our ways,
units.rightText: Why should any mortal man complain, Let us examine and test our ways,

units.leftText: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens. “We have transgressed and have rebelled.
units.rightText: Let us lift up our hearts and hands “We have sinned and rebelled;

units.leftText: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have covered yourself with a cloud,
units.rightText: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have covered Yourself with a cloud

units.leftText: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
units.rightText: You have made us scum and refuse All our enemies

units.leftText: Terror and the pit have come on us, My eye runs down with streams of water,
units.rightText: Panic and pitfall have come upon us — Streams of tears flow from my eyes

units.leftText: My eye pours down until the LORD looks down,
units.rightText: My eyes overflow unceasingly, until the LORD

units.leftText: My eye affects my soul, They have chased me relentlessly like a bird,
units.rightText: My eyes bring grief to my soul Without cause my enemies

units.leftText: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, Waters flowed over my head.
units.rightText: They dropped me alive into a pit The waters flowed over my head,

units.leftText: I called on your name, LORD, You heard my voice:
units.rightText: I called on Your name, O LORD, You heard my plea:

units.leftText: You came near in the day that I called on you. Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul.
units.rightText: You drew near when I called on You; You defend my cause, O Lord;

units.leftText: LORD, you have seen my wrong. You have seen all their vengeance
units.rightText: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; You have seen all their malice,

units.leftText: You have heard their reproach, LORD, the lips of those that rose up against me,
units.rightText: O LORD, You have heard their insults, the slander and murmuring of my assailants

units.leftText: You see their sitting down and their rising up. You will pay them back, LORD,
units.rightText: When they sit and when they rise, You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD,

units.leftText: You will give them hardness of heart, You will pursue them in anger,
units.rightText: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them

units.leftText: How the gold has become dim! The precious sons of Zion,
units.rightText: How the gold has become tarnished, How the precious sons of Zion,

units.leftText: Even the jackals offer their breast. The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst.
units.rightText: Even jackals offer their breasts The nursing infant’s tongue

units.leftText: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom,
units.rightText: Those who once ate delicacies The punishment of the daughter of my people

units.leftText: Her nobles were purer than snow. Their appearance is blacker than a coal.
units.rightText: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, But now their appearance is blacker than soot;

units.leftText: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children.
units.rightText: Those slain by the sword are better off The hands of compassionate women

units.leftText: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. The kings of the earth didn’t believe,
units.rightText: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; The kings of the earth did not believe,

units.leftText: It is because of the sins of her prophets They wander as blind men in the streets.
units.rightText: But this was for the sins of her prophets They wandered blind in the streets,

units.leftText: “Go away!” they cried to them. The LORD’s anger has scattered them.
units.rightText: “Go away! Unclean!” The presence of the LORD has scattered them;

units.leftText: Our eyes still fail, They hunt our steps,
units.rightText: All the while our eyes were failing They stalked our every step,

units.leftText: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. The breath of our nostrils,
units.rightText: Those who chased us were swifter The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life,

units.leftText: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete;

units.leftText: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,
units.rightText: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,

units.leftText: We are orphans and fatherless. We must pay for water to drink.
units.rightText: We have become fatherless orphans; We must buy the water we drink;

units.leftText: Our pursuers are on our necks. We have given our hands to the Egyptians,
units.rightText: We are closely pursued; We submitted to Egypt and Assyria

units.leftText: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. Servants rule over us.
units.rightText: Our fathers sinned and are no more, Slaves rule over us;

units.leftText: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Our skin is black like an oven,
units.rightText: We get our bread at the risk of our lives Our skin is as hot as an oven

units.leftText: They ravished the women in Zion, Princes were hanged up by their hands.
units.rightText: Women have been ravished in Zion, Princes have been hung up by their hands;

units.leftText: The young men carry millstones. The elders have ceased from the gate,
units.rightText: Young men toil at millstones; The elders have left the city gate;

units.leftText: The joy of our heart has ceased. The crown has fallen from our head.
units.rightText: Joy has left our hearts; The crown has fallen from our head.

units.leftText: For this our heart is faint. for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate.
units.rightText: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate,

units.leftText: You, LORD, remain forever. Why do you forget us forever,
units.rightText: You, O LORD, reign forever; Why have You forgotten us forever?

units.leftText: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. But you have utterly rejected us.
units.rightText: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; unless You have utterly rejected us
